readerCopy.body: One clarified deadline, document, or requirement can turn uncertainty into something concrete enough to plan around. When Mercury sextiles Saturn, communication and structure cooperate, helping practical details become useful instead of merely restrictive. Contracts, schedules, applications, and difficult emails benefit from the added precision. Administrative clarity can prevent a much more expensive misunderstanding later.
